balls.text: full ball on leg-stump, and Jadeja flicks it straight to square leg.
Moves his front foot out of the line, carves through the line and hits it straight and flat over the bowler's head.
short ball, Jadeja opens his body to make some room but can't swing freely enough through the pull. Rolls down to deep midwicket.
walks across to a back of a length ball outside off, tries to swat it into the leg side, misses. Ball squirts into the off side off his pads.
Full, wide, and Dhoni swings viciously through the line, bringing his bottom hand into play to send the ball soaring over long off.
Shortish ball on off stump, Jadeja swats it down to long off.
Free hit. Jadeja swings at a leg-stump ball and misses, ball goes off his pad behind square leg.

he's gone! middle and leg, straightens, Jadeja thrusts his front foot across, and has to play around his front pad. Struck plumb in front. But wait! They check for the no ball, and his front foot is well in front of the crease.
Goes back, pushes it carefully to midwicket.
driven straight to cover and runs, Suryakumar Yadav throws to the bowler, who fumbles. Direct hit would have had Jadeja struggling.
Comes a couple of steps down the pitch, chips it over cover.
straight, skids on, beats Jadeja for pace as he tries to flick and hits his front pad. Inside-edge, possibly, and no one appeals.
Nurdled square on the leg side off the back foot.
Full, straight, Jadeja leans back to make himself space to shovel the ball way over deep midwicket. Shot!
slower ball, pulled to deep midwicket.
short, wide of off stump, rising. Dhoni slashes and misses.
Russell strikes! full ball, wide of off stump, McCullum goes low and slashes, but it slices off his bat and straight into the hands of deep point.
slower ball, struck on the pads as he tried to pull. No one appealed
Full, on off stump, Dhoni opens his front foot a touch and swivels powerfully through the shot to send it skimming straight back past the bowler. Lots of bottom-hand there.
sharp turn, but Dhoni is back to push it gently into the covers.
slower, tossed up a touch, swept to deep square leg.
Dhoni comes forward, gets a thickish leading edge to cover as the ball straightens off the pitch.
stays back, opens the face, steers it to short third man.
shortish, wide outside off, straightens a touch. Chopped to deep point.
Not that short, offbreak, McCullum pulls anyway down to deep midwicket.
Short again, but no room for those arms to swing, hit weakly to long-on.
Short, and McCullum's eyes light up, but it's a slower ball. Much slower than he expected, and he's through the pull shot before the ball even reaches him. Ball rolls down to the keeper.
full toss outside off stump. Dhoni goes back and across, punches it down to long-off.
short, wide, Dhoni hits it on the jump wide of long-off, in typical Dhoni fashion.
comes forward, pokes it into the off side with an open face.
Length ball outside off. Dhoni stays back, tries to heave across the line, gets an inside edge into the leg side.
off-cutter again. Dhoni walks across his stumps and helps it to short fine leg.
full, outside off, pushed towards cover point.
short, pulled, six. Have we seen this somewhere? That shot brings up fifty for McCullum.
driven firmly to mid-off.
Another off-cutter, back of a length, cut away down to deep point.
slower ball, off-cutter, McCullum waits on it and opens his bat-face to dink it into the off side.
full, wide, driven to the left of long-off.
plonks his front foot down, but waits on the ball before nurdling it square on the leg side.
he's gone! comes down the track and hits a full-toss straight down the throat of long-on. He seemed to cramp himself for room, and didn't get a free swing of his arms.
Full again, Raina makes room and places it perfectly with a full face to cover's left, screams to the ropes.
Quick, flat, fired across the left-hander, who tries to heave and misses.
Full, on leg stump. Driven down to long on.
jumps down the track, tries to defend but misses, ball goes off Raina's front pad into the off side.
short ball, Raina goes back in his crease, flips his wrists over, and the ball splits deep midwicket and long on.
full, wide, lovely drive, cut off by long-off.
worked away down to long on.
down the pitch, it's just a chip with a straight bat but it flies way over the straight boundary.
Short, bit of turn, McCullum hits it airily, on the bounce, to deep point.
shortish, on off stump this time. Played down to deep point with an open bat-face.
fuller, McCullum makes room to push it into the covers.
Vinay is bowling like a bowling machine set to 'short'. McCullum pulls a little later, and it goes fine for another boundary.
Vinay keeps bowling short, McCullum keeps pulling. He finds the gap this time, as anyone will given so many opportunities to play the same shot. Ball bounces just short of the rope.
not that short this time, but McCullum pulls again, and pulls well, square. Deep square leg doesn't have as much running to do this time.
short again, pulled again, but he hasn't hit it too well. Deep square leg runs around to his left to cut it off at the rope.
defended solidly off the front foot.
Skids on from outside off. McCullum cuts it to deep point.
Slower, fuller, legbreak. McCullum is drawn forward and beaten by the turn.
Short again, and McCullum never misses out on those. In position early to pull well wide of deep midwicket.
Full, on leg stump, may have been a googly, but Raina is untroubled as he pushes down to long on.
Turn for Chawla, but his length is still too short. Raina gets it down to long off, plays with a straight bat.
short ball on off stump, McCullum is waiting for precisely that. Pulls it remorselessly over the deep midwicket boundary.
Bit of shape towards Raina's pads, worked to deep midwicket.
Angled across Raina, who opens his bat face and tries to steer it behind point. Hits it to the fielder.
Angled towards leg, McCullum is hit on the pad as he misses the flick.
Short ball, good carry, keeps rising as it passes McCullum's head. Tries to pull, but misses.
Bit of shape away. McCullum goes back, cuts to point.
width, Raina is on the back foot once more, hits it with a straight bat to cover.
Bit of turn here, legbreak, Raina gives himself room but has to adjust quickly to pat it to safety.
Another shortish ball, another ball chopped down to the off-side sweeper.
Short ball, similar shot from Raina to the first ball, fielded on the slide by Yusuf Pathan at deep point. Oh, hang on. He's touched the rope with his foot as he did so.
similar length, straighter, defended off the back foot.
Skids through with the arm, not that short, but Raina goes deep in his crease and guides it  nicely behind point.
down the pitch once more, driven hard but straight to long-on.
back and across, tennis-style swat down to long off.
down the track, not anywhere near the pitch, jams down on the ball straight to the bowler.
comes down the track, taken on the full, flicked straight to deep midwicket.
goes with the arm this time, played away uncertainly towards square leg, off the inside half of the bat.
Full, on leg stump. McCullum defends inside-out.
swept straight to square leg.
huge turn, there. Raina thinks about playing it, but pulls his bat out of the way as it screams past his edge.
Turned away into the midwicket region, off the back foot.
big, sharp turn, and the ball jams off the inside edge behind square on the leg side. Fielder hits the stumps direct at the bowler's end, but Raina is well in.
turn for Narine, but McCullum is in position really early to pull it away powerfully over midwicket.
turns away from McCullum, finds his outside edge as he plays it off the back foot. Ball squirts away between point and short third man.
pushed down the ground to mid-off.
defended watchfully into the off side.
Length ball, kept a bit low. Raina jams his bat down to hit it towards square leg.
he's got him, after all! tries to sweep, misses. Ball straightens and hits his back pad, in front of the stumps. That looked plumb.
similar ball to that dead ball, but Smith stays balanced and hits it cleanly over the long off boundary.
nudged to square leg
Turns in this time, McCullum tries to force it behind square, hits it straight to point.
Straightens from off stump. McCullum plays it watchfully off the back foot towards the covers.
batsman waits on it this time, allows it to turn in, plays it down to long on.
same line, fuller, defended off the front foot.
back of a length, straightens, defended off the back foot.
shot! It's on leg stump, and continues further down that angle, but Smith pulls out the reverse-sweep nonetheless.
better line, on middle, defended down to the bowler.
drifting onto the pads once again, and McCullum is on his way with a fine glance. Not good bowling when you have fine leg in the circle.
angling in towards the pads, worked away down to long-on.
Drifts down the leg side, swept away powerfully behind square.
Tries to sweep, misses, muted appeal for lbw, would have slid down leg.
Leg and middle, on a good length. Smith plays it cautiously back to the bowler.
He can. It's a slower ball, angled into the left-hander from around the wicket, and he waits on it before dabbing it behind point.
Full, angled in, lbw. Pathan looks to slog across the line, and misses. Hits him right in front of off stump. Plumb.
Full, wide outside off, and Chawla swings it straight down long-off's throat.
Short, rising ball outside off. Pathan top-edges the attempted pull, but it falls well short of deep square leg.
tries to chop it to point, gets an inside-edge that squirts into the leg side.
Full, straight, in the blockhole, hit down to long-on.
Full, just outside off. Yusuf swings hard, but can't get the elevation this time. Skids down to long-on.
Wide outside off again, gives Yusuf a lot of room to swing. He makes clean contact, and it goes way over long-on.
wide yorker, testing the limits of the wide rule. Yusuf lets it go, but the umpire is unmoved.
Hilfy pulls his length back, short outside off, and beats Yusuf on the pull.
The bottom hand comes off the bat, but he still sends this length ball soaring over the ropes.
Big clean swing of those arms and the ball goes sailing over the midwicket boundary.
Another slower-ball, another across-the-line heave, another batsman beaten. This time, it's straight, and it crashes into middle stump.
Full, almost in the blockhole, tucked behind square on the leg side.
Another one out of the back of his hand. It even turns a bit, away from Pathan, as he looks to heave it away to the leg side and misses.
Full-toss, swung down to long-on.
Another slower ball, outside off, heave and miss from Russell and the ball goes rolling down to Dhoni.
Slower ball, clubbed away to deep midwicket.
Quicker ball, and Russell can only pat it back to the bowler. End of a top spell from Jadeja, on a pitch designed for his style of bowling.
Stretches forward to defend.

he's been missing the reverse-sweep for a while, and the shot gets Uthappa out now. Off his glove, into the forearm, and lobs in the air for Dhoni to pouch running a few steps to his right. Jadeja appeals like mad, and the umpire tells him to turn around. Uthappa had already started walking.
driven down to long-on from outside off.
Clubs a length ball wide of long-on, who has a bit of running to do to his right to make the stop.
Quick, back of a length, Uthappa tries to pull, hits it down to long-on.
carrom ball outside leg, full, and Pathan sweeps it wide of short fine leg. Not the best ball to bowl with that fielder in the circle.
short ball. Pathan leans back and clubs it mightily over deep midwicket.
slow ball dangled outside off, heaves and misses.
pushed down the ground, but still no single.
quickish ball on leg stump, and Yusuf is hit on the pads, too late on the sweep.
Full offbreak on off, and Yusuf defends to mid-on.
heaved across the line to deep midwicket.
too full and fast to reverse-sweep, goes off the toe-end towards mid-off.
tries to come down the track, Jadeja bowls it quicker, forces him to defend.
top-edges the reverse-sweep, sends it ballooning over slip.
pushed down the ground to long-off.
Pushes forward to defend, no turn, but he's still beaten.
worked to square leg off the pads.
tries to cut, is beaten.
goes back and across, Ashwin fires a quick offbreak on off stump, defended.
short, pulled to deep midwicket.
Makes room to cut, in front of point.
Offbreak, bit of turn from outside off, flicked to midwicket.
Full, hits Uthappa on the toe as he tries to flick, loud appeal from Dhoni. Ball was headed comfortably down the leg side.
Goes with the arm once more, Uthappa stretches forward to defend.
worked away to deep midwicket for the walked single.

Another skidder, another failed sweep, and the finger goes up for the lbw shout. The ball hits Yadav on the back thigh, and he might be a touch unlucky, because that hit him on a line a little bit outside off.
beaten trying to sweep from outside off. Ball skidded through.
goes back, pushes it to the off-side sweeper, thinks about two but Yadav sends him back, with good reason. Mohit makes good ground and sends in a powerful throw.
tries the reverse-sweep from outside leg, doesn't make a great connection, trickles down to mid-off.
carrom ball again, on off stump, Yadav makes room, clubs it down to long-off.
swept to deep square leg.
very full, flicked off his toes to deep midwicket.
outside leg again, paddled fine.
Down the track, Ashwin bowls a carrom ball outside leg. Uthappa defends down the pitch.
Worked towards midwicket.
Super shot! Uthappa is on the front foot, but he's still perfectly balanced to play the cut behind point.
pushed down to long-on.
tries to slog-sweep, goes off his body towards third man, where Manhas makes a good diving stop.
Down the track, clipped off the pads to deep midwicket.
cheeky! Late cut, almost out of Dhoni's gloves, big chase for Jadeja from point.
short midwicket is in place, and Yadav finds him as he tries to flick.
Tries a big heave across the line, squirts it behind square for one.
shot! Having hit the last ball straight to that fielder, Uthappa reverse-sweeps this one past point.
Turn from outside off, cut straight to point.
bit of turn from leg and middle. Defended carefully down the pitch.
quick and straight, defended towards mid off.
Ball stops on him from wide of off stump, and keeps a bit low, goes under the bat as he tries to cut.
No hat trick. Uthappa comes forward, guides it square on the off side.
No he can't! Slogs his first ball straight to deep midwicket, where Mohit Sharma takes a good catch diving forward and to his left. Ball was swirling quite a bit.
and he gets a wicket first ball! Stops on Pandey outside off stump, and he checks his shot halfway into a drive, pops it straight into cover's hands.
length ball, on leg stump, worked into the leg side.
Nearly gets another! Uthappa slog-sweeps, and Raina dives forward from deep midwicket, but the ball bounces just in front of him.
Bad ball gets Kallis! Wide outside leg stump, and he sweeps uppishly, straight to deep backward square leg, one of two fielders on the leg-side boundary.
pushed back towards the bowler.
Kallis tries to make room again, and is beaten outside off as he tries to drive.
Full toss, clipped down to long-on.
Shot! Down the track, takes a step away from the line, crunches it between cover and mid off.
Kallis makes room, steers it straight to point.
Goes back to a fullish ball on middle stump to flick it to deep square leg.
Short, outside off, sits up for Uthappa to pull it over the long-on boundary.
Comes down the track, gives himself room to slash it behind point.
Flicked to square leg from middle stump.
Back of a length, tight on off stump, Kallis goes back and tries to cut, but doesn't have too much room, and he chops it straight to point.
pushed down to deep midwicket.

run out! Uthappa takes two steps down and inside-edges as he tries to swat across the line. Gambhir sets off for a run even though the ball is in Dhoni's hands. Hilfenhaus collects the keeper's throw halfway down the pitch, runs back and underarms it to the stumps.
Back of a length, Gambhir wrists it down into the leg side, on the hop.
back of a length, defended down the pitch.
super shot. angles into Uthappa, and he leans forward and twirls his wrists delightfully to beat mid on.
Full, wide, leans forward to drive crisply through the covers.
curls in off a fuller length, hits Gambhir on the pads as he tries to flick.
Short, wide, slashed away over the point region.
Back of a length, Gambhir can't time it cleanly as he tries to pull.
Short, swings away, Uthappa nowhere near it as he tries to pull.
lovely ball, swings away from back of a length, and Uthappa is beaten once more. No footwork once again.
full toss at shoulder height, Gambhir somehow slaps it wide of point.
angled across, Gambhir jumps and squirts it down defensively.
angled into leg stump, prodded down to mid-on.
shapes away again, straighter, defended down the ground.
Bit of outswing and Uthappa is beaten as he pokes outside off stump without moving his feet.
